responses.text: {Player in combat} Fuck off! I ain't helping you!
I got nothing you need. If it's ass you're looking for, talk to Pretty Sarah.
Me and my partner Saint James work salvage around Westside, that's all.

topics.prompt: What do you do around here?

responses.text: {'Cause} Because it's his name. He may be high-strung, but he's all right. Hauls his half of scrap, which is all I need.

topics.prompt: Why is your partner called Saint James?

responses.text: Don't believe everything you hear. Me and Saint James earn our caps working salvage.
It's hard work, so when I'm not working I like to relax. Which means it's time for you to fuck off.
Like I told you, we work salvage. We aren't coyotes. And like I told you, fuck off.

topics.prompt: I hear you and your partner are coyotes.

responses.text: You're right about that. {shouting for your partner, starting combat} Saint James! Got a thief here!

topics.prompt: I know what you and your partner have been up to - I got the evidence from your rooms.
